212.subject: Botany
212.text: Which is the longest phase of the cell cycle?
212.sol: Cell cycle is divided into 2 phases. (i) Interphase (a period of preparation for cell division), (ii) M phase (the actual period of cell division). 71564.text: Which is the driving force for the process of passive absorption of water in roots?
71564.sol: Passive absorption of water by roots is driven by the transpiration pull created in the leaves. As water evaporates from the stomata during transpiration, a negative pressure or tension develops in the xylem vessels of the leaves. This tension is transmitted downwards through the continuous water column in the xylem to the roots, creating a suction force that pulls water from the soil into the root hairs. 78756.text: What is the equation of the plane passing through the point (1, 1, 1) and perpendicular to the line whose direction ratios are 3, 2, 1 ?

132424.text: A pea plant with yellow and round seeds is self-pollinated. It produces a progeny consisting of only yellow-round and green-round plants. What fraction of this total progeny will be homozygous for both seed colour and seed shape?

When YyRR is self-pollinated (YyRR YyRR), the progeny genotypes will be: 1 4 YYRR 1 2 YyRR 1 4 yyRR The plants homozygous for both traits are YYRR and yyRR. Total fraction = 1 4 + 1 4 = 1 2 . Tunicates, Cyclostomes, Chondrichthyes, Osteichthyes and Amphibians
95517.sol: Phylum Chordates are divided into three subgroups: Urochordates, Cephalochordates and Vertebrates. First two sub groups are collectively known as Protochordates. 95650.sol: Entamoeba is an intestinal parasite in humans and is a part of amoeboid protozoans. Plasmodium causes malaria and is a sporozoan since it has a spore-like infective stage in its life cycle. Trypanosoma which causes sleeping sickness has flagella, and hence, it is a flagellated protozoan. Paramecium is an aquatic, actively moving organism because of the presence of thousands of cilia.
